trust.authority: Pinned independently in the installer; catalog downloads cannot replace publisher trust or the verifier.

runtime.name: FadedCore runtime 0.4.0 RC1
runtime.description: Capability contract 1: owned NPC/actions/events, authenticated PNG/PCM WAV/textured mesh content, native definitions, map/camera/needs and owned state. Requires installer 0.3.20. Runtime upgrades preserve the existing mod selection; new bundled branding/examples are not added automatically. Fresh installs enable local branding; gameplay/SDK acceptance stay disabled.

sdk.name: FadedCore developer SDK 0.4.0 (preview)
sdk.description: Authors only: compatible API 1/2 SDK, templates, content preparation/examples, helper 0.4 and rebased documentation. New capability services require minimumRuntime 0.4.0; build then separately sign/package each mod. Players do not need this ZIP.
sdk.licenseStatus: No first-party license grant is added; owner license selection remains required before a production SDK release.

limitations: Requires installer 0.3.20 or later with authenticated helper 0.4.0; old clients retain legacy catalog entries.
Owned NPC spawning is solo-host only; client initialization is unavailable and connected multiplayer/late join remain unverified.
Online badge describes local runtime readiness, not a multiplayer connection.
Full live-actor scene teardown, custom-item firing/reload/saved-session reload, map panning, completed rest and outdoor camera/firing transitions remain unqualified.
Comparative performance remains partial; SDK remains developer preview with no added first-party license grant.
Runtime updates preserve installed mod selections; bundled acceptance examples are disabled and do not activate automatically.
